questions.text: Gloria is playing a game where she tells you two truths and one lie about herself. Which of these statements is the lie?
options: I was born when my parents' ages both contained the numbers 2 and 3
When I turned 18, my mother was 50 years old and my father was 41
My parents were both born on February 29, 11 years apart?
questions.why: Two ways to deduce. 1) Assume A is true; that means 32 and 23, so from B, 32 + 18 = 50 and 23 + 18 = 41, so B is also correct; C is the lie. 2) C can never be true as Feb. 29 only happens every 4 years and 11 is not a multiple of 4.
